visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a tight close-up shot of a decorative golden bowl sitting on a flat surface. Inside the bowl, a small white candle is lit, flickering softly. A hand enters the frame from the left, holding a burning wooden matchstick that produces a bright orange flame and a trail of white smoke against a dark, moody background. (2) Transitioning to a medium shot, a young woman with long, dark wavy hair is positioned centrally. She is wearing a cream-colored zip-up hoodie over a shirt with text. She smiles brightly at the lens while speaking, framed by a stylized light-blue graphic that reads 'Winter Solstice' in elegant script. (3) The camera moves to a close-up focusing on a plain white sheet of paper. A hand holding a black felt-tip marker writes Chinese characters on the paper. The lighting is low and atmospheric, emphasizing the movement of the pen and the texture of the paper under the warm glow of nearby light. (4) The woman holds the white paper towards the camera, pointing at a large '11' graphic overlay with her finger. She uses expressive hand gestures, moving her palms to emphasize her spoken points while maintaining eye contact with the viewer. (5) A montage sequence shows the woman folding the written paper into small rectangular strips and dropping them into the golden bowl containing the candle. Her movements are deliberate and ritualistic, set against a dark background that highlights the candle's glow. (6) A brief visual effect appears showing a rotating spiral galaxy in deep space, overlaid on the woman's hands as she gestures outwards. She continues to speak directly to the camera with a warm, encouraging facial expression. (7) The final phase shows the woman holding the golden bowl filled with folded paper strips, smiling and bringing her hands together in a prayer-like gesture of gratitude. Social media interface overlays like 'Save' and 'Remix' icons appear at the bottom of the frame.
